newsitem.title: USA: Holly Holdings unit in settlement pact.
newsitem.headline: Holly Holdings unit in settlement pact.

text.p: Holly Holdings Inc said that its majority-owned subsidiary, Country World Casinos Inc, has reached an agreement settling litigation and other issues with New Allied Development Corp.
It said lawyers for both sides are finalizing documents and formal closing is set for June 2.

Holly Holdings said terms of the agreement call for a global settlement of all outstanding issues between the parties, including the dismissal of all federal and state litigation and the forgiveness of all indebtedness due from Country World to New Allied.
In addition, the settlement provides for the conversion of the series A preferred Stock held by New Allied into common stock of Country World, it said.
Country World Casinos is a development corporation, whose plan is to construct a casino in Black Hawk, Colo.
William Patrowicz, president of Holly Holdings, said that after the settlement is completed, the company expects to sign documents to finance the project in the next few weeks.
